Watch video Out of stock Overview Features Videos Technical Downloads Out of stock “The Germanium Tumnus is our tribute to classic pedal designs, but with a unique twist.” Right facing | Front | Left facing | Back | Top |' data-navmenu="off" data-hashurl="off" data-menuSlider="off" data-continue-autoplay="off" data-outside-nav="off" data-autoplay="off" > 4 5 SOLD OUT There is one overdrive circuit to this day that has been among the most talked about, the most sought after, and the most mythical of them all. It‘s that legendary tone that every guitarist dreams of. Brian Wampler captured that magic with his original Tumnus circuit, and it has since graced the pedalboards of thousands of players around the world. The Tumnus has withstood the test of time and held its own in countless pedal shootouts, often coming out on top even against the original Klon pedal. The allure of that original overdrive had a lot to do with a very specific “secret” germanium diode, dubbed “unobtanium” by the original creator, Bill Finnegan. It was said that these diodes were the heartbeat of the coveted tone, but they had run out long ago. Despite this Wampler fans have been asking Brian to create a Tumnus using the same vintage specification clipping diode from those early Klons. After a massive hunt Brian found a small stash of these elusive diodes and used them to create a limited-edition run of pedals - the Germanium Tumnus. The Germanium Tumnus is a versatile addition to any pedal board. Stack it with another pedal to help push or shape the total amount of gain, use it as a slightly dirty boost to push the front end of your amp over the edge, or use it as a standalone overdrive pedal and let it roar as nature intended. $ 179.97 Out of stock SKU: WMP-TGE-PED-SIL Categories: Boost & Utilities , Distortion / Overdrive Tags: boost , overdrive warning Cancer and Reproductive Harm www.p65warnings.ca.gov A Twist on a Classic There is a reason the Tumnus has gained the reputation it has – it provides the perfect high headroom overdrive to send your tone into the place you’ve always dreamed it would go. The Germanium Tumnus adds an extra dimension with Germanium clipping diodes that help give this circuit some extra sizzle. This pedal will satisfy both the pedal connoisseur and those seeking a new workhorse on their board. Always the Right Fit If you want a pre-gain boost to fatten up your tone… the Germanium Tumnus delivers. If you want a standalone overdrive…. the Germanium Tumnus delivers. If you want…well, you get the picture here. Set the gain around 9 o’clock for a beautiful smooth boost and at noon for a fuller voiced, meaty drive. Turn the gain all the way up for a brutal, yet creamy overdriven tone. The Germanium Tumnus, like its golden sibling, delivers. Brian’s Special Stash After a massive hunt Brian sourced a quantity of vintage specification Germanium diodes and used them to create this limited-edition run of pedals – the Germanium Tumnus was born. This edition is steeped in a level of exclusivity with a tone that’s set to become legendary. This stash of “secret diodes” is limited, giving you a rare opportunity to own a piece of tone shaping history. Once they’re gone, they’re gone and this pedal will be discontinued. Wampler Pedals Germanium Tumnus | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Overdrive / Wampler Pedals Germanium Tumnus Germanium Tumnus The Wampler Germanium Tumnus is a limited-edition overdrive pedal that captures the highly sought-after tone of the original Klon pedal. Featuring vintage-specification germanium diodes and a versatile design, this pedal offers a range of tones from a clean boost to a full, creamy overdrive. The Germanium Tumnus is praised for its ability to enhance any guitar's sound, offering a smooth overdrive boost when stacked with other pedals. Its three controls for Volume, Gain, and Treble allow for precise tone shaping, making it an ideal addition to any guitarist's pedalboard. What Wampler Pedals say about the Germanium Tumnus Introducing the Limited Edition Wampler Germanium Tumnus Deluxe. It's a Tumnus, it’s a deluxe, and it's loaded with the same style of hyper-rare germanium diodes as the elusive Klon Centaur and the sold-out Germanium Tumnus. This is my shot at the ultimate Klon-style overdrive. You all sure love the Germanium Tumnus! It was almost sold out before it even shipped. Never fear if you missed your chance to get one, though. The Ltd. Germanium Tumnus Deluxe is the quintessential blend of that same authentic tone and added versatility. With a 3-band EQ, buffer bypass switch, controls for level and gain, and a hot switch for increased gain, you can think of it as an upgraded Germanium Tumnus, an even more versatile Klon, or a killer overdrive/boost pedal in its own right. However you see it—or use it—you'll love it. I only had so many of these "magic" diodes, so, like the first Germanium Tumnus, production is extremely limited. Assuming you haven't bought them up already, you'll want to act fast. When they're gone, they're gone. Limited Edition, You Know the Drill! I only have a limited supply of those vintage diodes, so this pedal won't be around long. If you're curious, move quick. You won't regret it. www.wamplerpedals.com What guitarists say... Guitarists raved about the Wampler Germanium Tumnus, with many comparing it favorably to the original [Klon]. Users praised its versatile tones, ranging from a clean boost to a full, meaty overdrive. Reviewers particularly liked how the pedal enhanced their playing style. The Germanium Tumnus proved popular with both single coil and humbucker users. Many guitarists who owned other versions of the [Tumnus] series found this to be their favorite. Read reviews on www.wamplerpedals.com Germanium Tumnus compared to ...
